result.instructions: Tools for Canvas Medical, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Canvas Medical data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run canvas_medical_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run canvas_medical_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run canvas_medical_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. canvas_medical_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: canvas_search
tools.title: Search a FHIR resource
tools.description: Search any supported FHIR R4 resource in the chart. Pick `resource`, then narrow with the standard FHIR search parameters. Nearly every clinical question starts here: Condition or Observation for a problem list and results, MedicationRequest for prescriptions, Appointment or Encounter for visits, DocumentReference for notes. Canvas: GET /{resource}.

resource.description: Which FHIR resource type to search.

patient.description: Restrict to one patient, by Patient id. The usual first filter.

status.description: FHIR status filter, e.g. active, completed, cancelled.

date.description: FHIR date filter, e.g. "ge2026-08-01" or "lt2026-09-01". Prefixes: eq, ne, gt, lt, ge, le.

identifier.description: Search by business identifier, e.g. an MRN.

name.description: Name search, for Patient and Practitioner.

_id.description: Fetch by resource id through search.

_sort.description: Sort field, e.g. -date for newest first.

tools.name: canvas_read
tools.title: Read one FHIR resource
tools.description: Fetch a single FHIR resource by type and id. Canvas: GET /{resource}/{id}.

resource.description: Which FHIR resource type to read.

tools.name: canvas_get_patient_everything
tools.title: Get everything for one patient
tools.description: Fetch a patient's full record in one FHIR bundle — conditions, medications, observations, encounters and more. The fastest way to answer a broad question about one person, but it can return a large document, so prefer canvas_search when you know which resource you need. Canvas: GET /Patient/{id}/$everything.

tools.name: canvas_get_capability_statement
tools.title: Get the FHIR capability statement
tools.description: Fetch the server's FHIR CapabilityStatement — exactly which resources, interactions and search parameters this Canvas instance supports. Read it when a search is rejected and you want to know what the instance actually accepts. Canvas: GET /metadata.
